## Source cause and resulting order

Prior server public quiesce called DriveRuntime.quiesce → DriveRunner.stop → shared Drive execution.stop before machine/LLM caller drain. A machine extraction/body callback could subsequently request its normal final-check withCaller from a no-longer-accepting shared execution. This is a static shutdown contract contradiction; it is not an observed native abort cause.

server.node.ts now sets frontdoor accepting=false and synchronously begins machineRunner.stop, llmRunner.stop and DriveRuntime.quiesce before awaiting their allSettled results. New queue/HTTP admission is stopped while shared Drive stays available for existing callers' normal final-check/ACK. Only fulfilled quiesce proceeds to DriveRuntime.stop. Launcher-first quiesce and direct shutdown share cached quiescing/shuttingDown Promises. After all three settle an original rejection is rethrown unchanged and stays cached; final shared stop is not reached on rejection. Remaining original resource shutdown order follows DriveRuntime final stop.

DriveRuntime.quiesce clears its existing interval, aborts/drains tracked HTTP tasks and awaits queue quiesce, without execution.stop. Queue quiesce sets original stopping/again/backupAgain flags and awaits already-running/backingUp tasks. Existing wake/finally guards block restart. Cached drain/stop Promises preserve repeated-call identity and rejection. DriveRuntime.stop calls original DriveRunner.stop only after quiesce success. Original DriveRunner.stop function from async stop() through file end has direct full-byte equality to parent. It retains original execution.stop, closure reconciliation, unacknowledged/predecessor rejection and maintenance. Native/proof/ACK/unknown-release/withCaller/accepting predicates are not weakened.

Its stop now retains timer clear/await active/cancel order, then awaits original machine.execution.stop before final recovery sweep. Existing NodeLlmExecution.stop stops new starts, aborts and awaits original operation.done callbacks and rejects unknown ownership; that adapter is unchanged. Machine and LLM retain the same existing execution references. A stop rejection prevents final shared Drive stop. No caller/native/termination Promise completion is synthesized and no universal bounded stop is claimed.

sweepMachine's default admit=true preserves normal recovery→claim behavior and evaluation order. Stop calls admit=false: existing recovery runs first, then return before claim, preventing a new stop-time machine job. No new limiter/counter/port/schema/timer/deadline or native capability is introduced.
